question.value: Why do dense molecular clumps survive so close in projection to the massive cluster R136 in 30 Dor, and what are their physical properties?

evidence.quote: We investigated the properties of molecular gas in the Stapler nebula to better understand why these clouds survive so close in projection to R136.
using the 7m ALMA Compact Array (ACA, also known as the Morita array) under project 2017.1.00368.S (PI M. Rubio)
The observations consist of two Band 7 correlator setups.
It has a central frequency of 338.5 GHz (0.88 mm), a total bandwidth of 13.5 GHz
during Cycle 5, using the 7m ALMA Compact Array (ACA, also known as the Morita array)
The spatial resolution is approximately 4.7$''$ for all cubes, which corresponds to 1.1 pc at a distance of 50 kpc.
The maximum recoverable scale (MRS) for the first setup is 19.1$''$ (4.6 pc) and for the second setup is 18.6$''$ (4.5 pc).

We used the `astropy.modelling` package to find the best fit for this region of the image.
The final catalog of $^{12}$CO clumps consists of 24 sources
These values represent between 50 and 85% of the total 0.88 mm flux measured in the ALMA images
The total gas masses $M^{LTE}_{gas}$ range between 203 and 1148 M$_{\odot}$.

findings_qualitative.value: Densest clumps (all species detected) lie along the NW-SE dark lane; clumps coincide with YSOs at the map center

evidence.quote: are concentrated in a northwest-southeast diagonal seen as a dark dust lane in HST images

claims.hypothesis: Dense molecular clumps near R136 are resolved into parsec-scale clumps
claims.finding: Stapler nebula resolves into sub-parsec to parsec clumps

evidence.quote: The final catalog of $^{12}$CO clumps consists of 24 sources

claims.experiment: Compare Mvir, CO mass, dust mass in same areas
claims.result: Mvir 2-5 times dust mass; CO and dust masses similar
claims.finding: velocity dispersion reflects external pressure plus self-gravity

evidence.quote: We found that the virial masses in this case are approximately two to five times larger than the gas masses obtained from dust emission in the same area

claims.hypothesis: Clump properties resemble other 30 Dor/LMC clumps
claims.experiment: Compare line ratios, Tex, column densities with literature
claims.finding: Clumps are densest parts of a cloud carved by R136

evidence.quote: We suggest that these clumps are the densest parts of a Molecular Cloud that has been carved by the strong radiation from R136

limitations_admitted.value: Most clumps unresolved; missing extended flux without Total Power data; non-LTE modeling out of scope

evidence.quote: Total Power (TP) observations would be necessary to detect extended continuum emission.
